simple.summary: בָּעוּ (bâʻûw) means a request First listed occurrence: Dan 6 8.

definitions.full: H1159. bau בָּעוּ (K § 61, 4 ) noun feminine petition ( ᵑ7 Syriac); — absolute ׳ב Dan 6:8 ; suffix בָּעוּתֵהּ 6:14 (both accusative of congnate meaning with verb with בְּעָא ).
